text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa is injured and should be
resting
at the infirmary, except...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Yo. Let's get back to training.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You're making a mountain out of a
molehill. It
doesn't even hurt anymore.
choice_data_list: ケガしたばかりなのに？

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing more boring than just
lying in
some bed all day.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: You really wanna subject me to that?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I'm not arguing against that. I'm saying
that
nothing's wrong with me right now.
choice_data_list: 安静にするのは大事なことだよ
なら、できる範囲で動かそう
choice_data_list_en: Then, let's move it as much as you can.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
choice_data_list: 問題を起こさないためにも絶対安静
choice_data_list_en: Strict bed rest, to make sure no problems arise.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Fine, I'll rest for today. I don't wanna
waste my
energy trying to convince you
if you're not gonna
listen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, Nakayama Festa reluctantly
leaves the
infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... All right. I guess it's better than
just going
to sleep.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Oh, crap. That just made it worse.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Man, things just can't go smoothly, can
they?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa's injury seems to be
worse than I
expected, so I take her
back to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...I shouldn't have a problem running this
much.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, I won't push myself to the
limit. That
would be a guaranteed game
ender rather than a
gamble.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Okay! One more lap just like that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa returns to training while
taking
care not to worsen her injury.
